Open your eyes and look at what they are really staging for us. On Sunday, March 29, in Hyderabad, Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR), the Sircilla MLA, publicly pointed the finger at the Congress government. But do not fall for their controlled opposition script—this is all part of a deeper manipulation by the hidden elites pulling the strings. 

KTR exposed what they call deep-seated corruption and a deliberate refusal to act against illegal mining, specifically calling out Raghava Constructions, a company tied directly to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy. This isn't just political theater; it is a carefully managed distraction to hide how the inner circle protects its own illicit operations while pretending to govern. 

Do not believe the official narrative or the sanitized updates they push through their approved channels. The whole system is rigged from the top down.
